name: Survey tile in Gemini
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Gemini, imaged by SPHEREx 15 times in 5 visits over 64 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 54 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.7 days starting 2025-10-17, at wavelengths from 1.12 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
